title: Autumn Leaves in Berlin - Quick Summary
items: **Beech peaks in the last full week of October.** Around Berlin the typical beech is half coloured on **21 October** and half bare on **4 November** (DWD records, 2015 to 2025).
**The other trees bracket it:** horse chestnut turns first (**8 October**), then birch (**15 October**), beech, and oak last (**23 October**, half bare **8 November**).
**In 2026 aim for the weekend of 24 and 25 October**, with Saturday 31 October as the backup. Single years move by about ten days, so decide two weeks out, not earlier.
**Go where the beech is, not simply far away.** Brandenburg's forest is about **70% pine** and Berlin's almost 65%, and pine does not change colour.
**The clocks go back on 25 October.** Sunset drops from **17:54** on the 24th to **16:40** by 31 October, so leave for Buckow or Chorin by noon after the change.
**Best trips:** Schlachtensee and Krumme Lanke in the city, **Liepnitzsee** (S2 and RB27), **Buckow** (RB26 and bus 928, hourly at weekends) and **Chorin** (RE3), all on the Deutschlandticket.
